Method of Attack: Fake Android SMS application acting as SMS relay for account creation services
Requests access to send and read SMS to intercept and forward OTP verification codes
Uses infected devices as virtual numbers to relay one-time passcodes for account verification
Exfiltrates SMS data to external domains
Freezes after installation preventing normal use while continuing malicious activity
Attack Vector: Malicious Android app installed from Google Play store
Requests SMS read/send permissions to intercept OTPs
Indicators of Compromise: Exfiltration of SMS data to domains used by 'Virtual Number' app
Multiple unexpected OTP messages received by users
Presence of apps on Google Play before removal
